programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. N, O, T and E make music - and S makes more and more of it!

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Flutter is sent to the ‘naughty berg’ as punishment when he falls foul of an old Piri rule. But when the others start telling tales, he’s not the only one to be banished.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: On a rare day without patients, Zog and Gadabout can’t wait to unwind - but Pearl can’t stop doctoring! They must help her relax before she bandages every creature in sight.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo are great at picking apples with Mojo’s crane top. But Preston’s drone might be even better... until it accidentally scoops up Felix. Mojo and Bo are on the chase!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Sula have a lovely time in the park clambering around on the trees. At first it is Sula who needs Bing's help to climb up, but when Bing climbs a bit too high, he gets stuck, and then he needs some help himself.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘ear’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. Today, we see lots of different ears – big, little, listening and funny ones. We meet a polar bear with chilly ears, and Dee goes into space to see an alien’s ears. The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs sneak out of bed in search of a tasty midnight feast. But can they creep past Mum and Dad’s room without making a noise? And more importantly, can they figure out why two of the crispy buns are already missing?

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Charlie has made a huge pie for the Piggies to share! But Wilf wants it all for himself and sabotages his own house to trap the Piggies outside. While they fix his home, Wilf settles in theirs... until the Piggies rush back to save their pie party!

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos find themselves in a restaurant and a waiter is taking the diners' orders. The chef rings the bell when the food is ready and the waiter collects it from the serving hatch. The waiter collects a delicious trifle but gets confused as to which way to go when the Twirlywoos keep ringing the bell. He goes this way and that way, eventually getting a taste of the trifle himself. The Box pays the Twirlywoos a visit. Leaves fly up out of the open Box. They are blown across the Big Red Boat and Peekaboo blows them straight back. The Twirlywoos follow the leaves this way and that way as The Box and Peekaboo blow the leaves to each other, over and over again.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friends visit a theme park and ride on a rollercoaster. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble and the Tumble Toys are very tired and need to sleep - except for the puppy!

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: It's a windy day in Teletubbyland and Dipsy's hat blows away. Po helps Dipsy get the hat back, while in Tummy Tales, children have fun playing on a windy beach.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Leo, Jack, Arabella, Emma, Jonas and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are hairbrushes which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby appropriate hairbrushes inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun song ‘This is the way we brush our hair’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children use nets to catch toy fish in a water tray, learning BSL signs for fish, why and bit, then they sing and sign One, Two, Three, Four, Five, Once I Caught a Fish Alive.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: Aaron, Mia and Jackson go on a splishy-splashy mission to water the garden and discover how plants drink, with help from Chatterpot, colourful experiments and clever roots!

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Kipekee the elephant has fun as she discovers the talents of the other animals. Hamza sees some oryx in the wild and spends time with the baby zebras at the orphanage.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Lou explains that growing is inevitable.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It's an adventure on the high seas as Bluey, Bingo and Missy play pirates on the hammock swing. They'll need to find their courage to withstand storms and whale attacks.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: It's a very hot day and Duggee's flowers are looking very sad. What can perk them up? Some water of course, but there's not a drop to be found. They need a bit of rain, but it's far too sunny today. How can they make the rain come? What about the rain dance! Who knows how to do a great dance? Duggee, of course! Duggee teaches the Squirrels the best rain dance ever and it really does work well. Now they can all do their crazy dancing in the rain!

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Welcome to Purple’s mixing factory, where he mixes two colours to create a new colour. In this musical episode, the Colourblocks learn that mixing red and yellow makes orange, whilst adding black and white helps to make darker and lighter colours. When the Printing Crew arrive, we learn how they work together to mix their colours and create new ones.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Micheal wants to find out all about devil's coach horse beetles in today’s episode. Chantelle meets some schoolchildren, and they look for a devil’s coach horse beetle in their fantastic nature garden, whilst Rory heads into the woods to meet a beetle expert. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files help explain all of Micheal's questions. With the help of the Teeny Tiny Creatures poem, we discover that, like lots of other teeny tiny creatures, devil's coach horse beetles are superheroes and help our planet in their own special way. In the Teeny Tiny Task, Chantelle and the children put their noses to the test with a supersmelly challenge!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Ted and his family visit a wildlife park, and Ted gets to be an animal keeper for the day. First, he feeds the hungry deer. They’re very friendly. Next, it’s onto the bison, who show Ted their giant tongues! Finally, Ted comes face to face with a very noisy and very hungry otter. Luckily, Ted speaks otter too!

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Children’s cookery series with Big Cook Jen and Little Cook Small. Jen and Small are having a movie night, but Jen has forgotten to buy some treats. Today’s cafe customer is Maverick the Movie Mouse, so they cook him a dish worthy of a movie star.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Diesel is a hearing dog for his teenage owner, Rayane, who is deaf. This means he doesn’t hear everything. Diesel is trained to listen out for important sounds that Rayane might miss. Diesel is Rayane’s ears. Together, they’re unstoppable! Diesel and Rayane are off to the park, where their football team are doing a sponsored fun run to raise the funds for a new kit. Diesel has a busy day ahead. First, he has to filter out all the sounds in the busy park to help Rayane find his friends Grace and Karim and the rest of his teammates at the start line. Then, he has to listen for the klaxon so he can let Rayane know the race is starting. He doesn’t want him to get left behind! Rayane’s football coach uses British Sign Language to communicate the rules of the race to the runners before they set off. Diesel has to run alongside Rayane and alert him to any danger or to anyone trying to get past. Karim is leading the field until he takes a wrong turn – and Rayane and Diesel set off in hot pursuit. Can they catch their friend and help him finish the race?

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: It’s autumn time. Jud, Jessica and their class visit a local park to collect leaves for an art project. Back at school, they use the leaves to create a huge leaf print picture - and things end up getting messy! The school playground is covered in leaves and the school caretaker, Mr Clever, needs help clearing them up. Luckily, he has a team of super leaf sweepers, who come to the rescue.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Simon is taking Jess out for a birthday dinner, so Gramps is on babysitting duty. He's brought along Mr Willow's dogs, Trevor and Violet, for the evening. They look just like Waffle, and during a game of hide-and-sing the dogs all hide next door, causing confusion and chaos for poor Mrs Hobbs!

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Double act Phoenix and Mossy are on their way to meet Oona when they find Spiky the hedgehog near the Bat Cave. He's far away from his burrows, and it's getting late. Poor wee fella, he's so small and helpless - they can't leave him on his own. They decide to take him home, but on their way to the Meadow, the friends learn not to judge a book by its very cute cover.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: When Toad finds himself with a case of puddle hiccups, it’s up to Yukee and the rest of the garden gang to find a cure.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: There's a new addition to the household with the arrival of Bruce the goldfish. On the face of it, he can't do tricks, he just blows bubbles and goes bloop. Maddie and Triggs begin to realise that all the great things they love to do are together. Maybe a friend in the tank is what Bruce needs for inspiration?

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: The full moon makes Wilf howl all night! The next morning, everyone is exhausted - and there’s a boulder blocking Brian’s door! He’s the only one who knows how to stop Wilf’s howling, so they need to budge that boulder.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Twelve shows the others how to put their blocks into columns and rows - and master the way of the rectangle. Learn about numbers that make rectangle shapes with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Do wishes come true? U doesn't think so but G says she can grow them. G is growing wishes but U doesn't believe in them, until something big happens and G's watering can ends up in a very high place. This episode has fun with 'ug' and the words jug, rug, tug and bug.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Educational series using Makaton sign language. Mr Tumble goes on a surprise bus journey with his family, while Justin and his friends go on a boat adventure!

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Laa-Laa makes up a lovely song about all of the things she sees on her walk across Teletubbyland. Afterwards, she sings a song to Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po. They sing the song together and watch a children's choir sing in Tummy Tales.

programme.title: Andy's Prehistoric Adventures
programme.desc: Andy leaps into his time-travelling clock to visit the fearsome sabre-toothed cat, but when his gizmo malfunctions, he is shrunk down to the size of an insect and must escape from a marauding prehistoric dung beetle!

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s stall. She chooses the cardboard tube and remembers the day she got it… Moira has allowed Suki to keep her pet mouse, Otto, in her office before his vet appointment - under strict instructions that his cage door stays closed. However, Moira can’t resist getting Otto out of his cage because he reminds her so much of the pet mouse she had when she was a child. When Moira breaks her own rule, Otto escapes. It’s a disaster! With Otto on the loose, it’s up to Daisy, Suki and Magnus to think of a clever and safe way to catch him.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies’ very own motorcycle rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines that are truly out of this world! Grace drives a Mars rover, shows off a space junk collector and looks to the skies with a telescope.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: Miss Collie has some exciting news - the school has a new cook who will introduce new food at lunchtimes. The pups don’t like the idea that their food might change, and they fear everything else will change at the school too. They decide to do something about it!

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: On the hottest day of the year, Book Cub is worried that she will run out of cups to serve fro-yo in, so Love Monster volunteers to look after her fro-yo van while she goes to get more. But after Bad Idea Puppy encourages him to give out extra fro-yo, he gets carried away and accidentally breaks the fro-yo machine, causing a nasty mess. When Book Cub returns, she is upset, but Love Monster apologises and together with Bad Idea Puppy they clean everything up.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: The Octonauts help when they discover melting permafrost endangering an ecosystem.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Mr McGregor goes away for the day, Peter can't wait to raid the garden. But will the absence of one foe leave Peter and his little sister at the mercy of another?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Zigzag has a sugar crash after eating too many sweet treats at the Explorers' Cookie Day.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea steals Supertato's brand new Tato Car but doesn't realise that the Grape Kids are in the back seat. Supertato has to get the Grape Kids back to safety and save his car.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The Ducklings are fed up with Weasy's immaturity, so they use a device to make him more sensible. But when Weasy becomes super serious, the Ducklings want their real dad back.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Tao can’t go on with his circus performance, so there are going to be some disappointed fans, unless Bo agrees to do all the acts for him - with some help from Mojo’s tops!

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: Zog is too scared to fly after a bad crash landing, so Boom helps the doctors as their ambulance. Zog must overcome his fear and get back to the team.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.desc: Andy and Jen jump into the magic old museum clock and travel 68 million years back in time for prehistoric adventures on Dino Island. The duo search for a missing baby Pachycephalosaurus called Bumper, who has become separated from his family. Jen looks for him in some nearby caves, while Andy heads to the river.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: AJ takes Evie and Anaya swimming, but Waffle must stay at home with Simon. Refusing to miss out on the fun, Waffle begins an adventure of his own and sets off to find Evie.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi wishes she was a cat so that she can have a relaxing day being just like Deborah! It is fun at first, but she quickly discovers the challenges. When they are stuck outside in the rain, Rafi admits being a cat is harder than she thought. With Deborah’s help, she returns inside and back to herself again. Together with her dads, they create a magical cat flap, so Deborah won’t get stuck outside ever again.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are at the beach and begin to look for lots of different types of shells. They also discover a rock pool, some limpets and a hermit crab – which runs away! JoJo realises that all the different elements at the beach make up an ecosystem, so she shouldn’t take any shells home.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Umbrella is nervous about meeting up with his pen pal at the Parasol Show, so Sarah and Duck accompany him.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: Tiny and Small find a strange silver ball. When it bounces it glows and rings. It bounces into Mother's garden and they are amazed to learn from her that the ball is a living thing, like them. And Granny is convinced it must have friends nearby.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: It’s a windy day, and MeMo and BaBa have fun playing with pinwheels. At Play Time, they fly a kite in the wind. The Yummies show MeMo and BaBa the wind chimes they have made out of recycled cutlery. The chimes sound beautiful as they move in the wind. On Lullaby Lake, Elewhale blows bubbles, and they are caught in the wind as MeMo and BaBa journey on to the Bay of Books for Storytime.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: Children's show about a magic place inhabited by toy characters. Igglepiggle tucks himself up in Upsy Daisy's bed. programme.title: CBeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: Join Christine and the Queens for a very special Bedtime Story celebrating the magical moon.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: The Go Jetters head to the ancient Peruvian city of Machu Picchu to watch Kyan compete in the Inca Trail Marathon. In the skies above, Grandmaster Glitch's mistake puts Machu Picchu is in danger and the Go Jetters must work with Glitch if they are to save the day.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Cheeky Peter Rabbit loves adventure but he struggles to stay out of trouble. Luckily his best friends are always around to help him out. Based on Beatrix Potter's classic stories.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Join an adventurous team of underwater explorers as they dive into action, rescuing all sorts of amazing sea creatures and trying their best to protect the ocean.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Superstar Fifty rocks out the Numberland stadium with her shining gold guitar. Learn how to count up in fives with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: The adventures of 26 lively letters who can make words come to life by holding hands. From A to Z, every Alphablock has fun discovering the magic of wordplay. N, O, T and E make music - and S makes more and more of it!

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: Flutter is sent to the ‘naughty berg’ as punishment when he falls foul of an old Piri rule. But when the others start telling tales, he’s not the only one to be banished.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: On a rare day without patients, Zog and Gadabout can’t wait to unwind - but Pearl can’t stop doctoring! They must help her relax before she bandages every creature in sight.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo are great at picking apples with Mojo’s crane top. But Preston’s drone might be even better... until it accidentally scoops up Felix. Mojo and Bo are on the chase!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Sula have a lovely time in the park clambering around on the trees. At first it is Sula who needs Bing's help to climb up, but when Bing climbs a bit too high, he gets stuck, and then he needs some help himself.

programme.title: Yakka Dee!
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say ‘ear’, and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. Today, we see lots of different ears – big, little, listening and funny ones. We meet a polar bear with chilly ears, and Dee goes into space to see an alien’s ears. The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way, and everyone has a boogie when Dee’s friend finally succeeds in saying today’s word.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: Maddie and Triggs sneak out of bed in search of a tasty midnight feast. But can they creep past Mum and Dad’s room without making a noise? And more importantly, can they figure out why two of the crispy buns are already missing?

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: Charlie has made a huge pie for the Piggies to share! But Wilf wants it all for himself and sabotages his own house to trap the Piggies outside. While they fix his home, Wilf settles in theirs... until the Piggies rush back to save their pie party!

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: The Twirlywoos find themselves in a restaurant and a waiter is taking the diners' orders. The chef rings the bell when the food is ready and the waiter collects it from the serving hatch. The waiter collects a delicious trifle but gets confused as to which way to go when the Twirlywoos keep ringing the bell. He goes this way and that way, eventually getting a taste of the trifle himself. The Box pays the Twirlywoos a visit. Leaves fly up out of the open Box. They are blown across the Big Red Boat and Peekaboo blows them straight back. The Twirlywoos follow the leaves this way and that way as The Box and Peekaboo blow the leaves to each other, over and over again.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Justin and his friends visit a theme park and ride on a rollercoaster. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble and the Tumble Toys are very tired and need to sleep - except for the puppy!

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: It's a windy day in Teletubbyland and Dipsy's hat blows away. Po helps Dipsy get the hat back, while in Tummy Tales, children have fun playing on a windy beach.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: Giovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Leo, Jack, Arabella, Emma, Jonas and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside everyone’s bags in this episode are hairbrushes which are explored through discovery, play, song and story. Grown-ups at home are encouraged to take part by hiding baby appropriate hairbrushes inside a fabric bag or pillowcase for them to reveal and explore with their baby! The fun song ‘This is the way we brush our hair’ features, as does a story involving Baby Bear. Plus, the Action Song gets everyone moving about, before some calm time with bubbles and the Goodbye Song.

programme.title: Tiny Tunes
programme.desc: Lisa and the children use nets to catch toy fish in a water tray, learning BSL signs for fish, why and bit, then they sing and sign One, Two, Three, Four, Five, Once I Caught a Fish Alive.

programme.title: I Can Grow It
programme.desc: Aaron, Mia and Jackson go on a splishy-splashy mission to water the garden and discover how plants drink, with help from Chatterpot, colourful experiments and clever roots!

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: Kipekee the elephant has fun as she discovers the talents of the other animals. Hamza sees some oryx in the wild and spends time with the baby zebras at the orphanage.

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Lou explains that growing is inevitable.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It's an adventure on the high seas as Bluey, Bingo and Missy play pirates on the hammock swing. They'll need to find their courage to withstand storms and whale attacks.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: It's a very hot day and Duggee's flowers are looking very sad. What can perk them up? Some water of course, but there's not a drop to be found. They need a bit of rain, but it's far too sunny today. How can they make the rain come? What about the rain dance! Who knows how to do a great dance? Duggee, of course! Duggee teaches the Squirrels the best rain dance ever and it really does work well. Now they can all do their crazy dancing in the rain!

programme.title: Colourblocks
programme.desc: Welcome to Purple’s mixing factory, where he mixes two colours to create a new colour. In this musical episode, the Colourblocks learn that mixing red and yellow makes orange, whilst adding black and white helps to make darker and lighter colours. When the Printing Crew arrive, we learn how they work together to mix their colours and create new ones.

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: Micheal wants to find out all about devil's coach horse beetles in today’s episode. Chantelle meets some schoolchildren, and they look for a devil’s coach horse beetle in their fantastic nature garden, whilst Rory heads into the woods to meet a beetle expert. Chantelle and Rory’s fact files help explain all of Micheal's questions. With the help of the Teeny Tiny Creatures poem, we discover that, like lots of other teeny tiny creatures, devil's coach horse beetles are superheroes and help our planet in their own special way. In the Teeny Tiny Task, Chantelle and the children put their noses to the test with a supersmelly challenge!

programme.title: Our Family
programme.desc: Ted and his family visit a wildlife park, and Ted gets to be an animal keeper for the day. First, he feeds the hungry deer. They’re very friendly. Next, it’s onto the bison, who show Ted their giant tongues! Finally, Ted comes face to face with a very noisy and very hungry otter. Luckily, Ted speaks otter too!

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: Children’s cookery series with Big Cook Jen and Little Cook Small. Jen and Small are having a movie night, but Jen has forgotten to buy some treats. Today’s cafe customer is Maverick the Movie Mouse, so they cook him a dish worthy of a movie star.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: Diesel is a hearing dog for his teenage owner, Rayane, who is deaf. This means he doesn’t hear everything. Diesel is trained to listen out for important sounds that Rayane might miss. Diesel is Rayane’s ears. Together, they’re unstoppable! Diesel and Rayane are off to the park, where their football team are doing a sponsored fun run to raise the funds for a new kit. Diesel has a busy day ahead. First, he has to filter out all the sounds in the busy park to help Rayane find his friends Grace and Karim and the rest of his teammates at the start line. Then, he has to listen for the klaxon so he can let Rayane know the race is starting. He doesn’t want him to get left behind! Rayane’s football coach uses British Sign Language to communicate the rules of the race to the runners before they set off. Diesel has to run alongside Rayane and alert him to any danger or to anyone trying to get past. Karim is leading the field until he takes a wrong turn – and Rayane and Diesel set off in hot pursuit. Can they catch their friend and help him finish the race?

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: It’s autumn time. Jud, Jessica and their class visit a local park to collect leaves for an art project. Back at school, they use the leaves to create a huge leaf print picture - and things end up getting messy! The school playground is covered in leaves and the school caretaker, Mr Clever, needs help clearing them up. Luckily, he has a team of super leaf sweepers, who come to the rescue.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: Simon is taking Jess out for a birthday dinner, so Gramps is on babysitting duty. He's brought along Mr Willow's dogs, Trevor and Violet, for the evening. They look just like Waffle, and during a game of hide-and-sing the dogs all hide next door, causing confusion and chaos for poor Mrs Hobbs!

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Double act Phoenix and Mossy are on their way to meet Oona when they find Spiky the hedgehog near the Bat Cave. He's far away from his burrows, and it's getting late. Poor wee fella, he's so small and helpless - they can't leave him on his own. They decide to take him home, but on their way to the Meadow, the friends learn not to judge a book by its very cute cover.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: When Toad finds himself with a case of puddle hiccups, it’s up to Yukee and the rest of the garden gang to find a cure.

programme.title: Maddie + Triggs
programme.desc: There's a new addition to the household with the arrival of Bruce the goldfish. On the face of it, he can't do tricks, he just blows bubbles and goes bloop. Maddie and Triggs begin to realise that all the great things they love to do are together. Maybe a friend in the tank is what Bruce needs for inspiration?

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: The full moon makes Wilf howl all night! The next morning, everyone is exhausted - and there’s a boulder blocking Brian’s door! He’s the only one who knows how to stop Wilf’s howling, so they need to budge that boulder.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Twelve shows the others how to put their blocks into columns and rows - and master the way of the rectangle. Learn about numbers that make rectangle shapes with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: Do wishes come true? U doesn't think so but G says she can grow them. G is growing wishes but U doesn't believe in them, until something big happens and G's watering can ends up in a very high place. This episode has fun with 'ug' and the words jug, rug, tug and bug.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Educational series using Makaton sign language. Mr Tumble goes on a surprise bus journey with his family, while Justin and his friends go on a boat adventure!

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: Laa-Laa makes up a lovely song about all of the things she sees on her walk across Teletubbyland. Afterwards, she sings a song to Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po. They sing the song together and watch a children's choir sing in Tummy Tales.

programme.title: Andy's Prehistoric Adventures
programme.desc: Andy leaps into his time-travelling clock to visit the fearsome sabre-toothed cat, but when his gizmo malfunctions, he is shrunk down to the size of an insect and must escape from a marauding prehistoric dung beetle!

programme.title: Molly and Mack
programme.desc: Molly examines her shelf of special things at the back of Mack’s stall. She chooses the cardboard tube and remembers the day she got it… Moira has allowed Suki to keep her pet mouse, Otto, in her office before his vet appointment - under strict instructions that his cage door stays closed. However, Moira can’t resist getting Otto out of his cage because he reminds her so much of the pet mouse she had when she was a child. When Moira breaks her own rule, Otto escapes. It’s a disaster! With Otto on the loose, it’s up to Daisy, Suki and Magnus to think of a clever and safe way to catch him.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: In this episode, CBeebies’ very own motorcycle rider, Grace, shows off three amazing machines that are truly out of this world! Grace drives a Mars rover, shows off a space junk collector and looks to the skies with a telescope.

programme.title: Dodge's Pup School
programme.desc: Miss Collie has some exciting news - the school has a new cook who will introduce new food at lunchtimes. The pups don’t like the idea that their food might change, and they fear everything else will change at the school too. They decide to do something about it!

programme.title: Love Monster
programme.desc: On the hottest day of the year, Book Cub is worried that she will run out of cups to serve fro-yo in, so Love Monster volunteers to look after her fro-yo van while she goes to get more. But after Bad Idea Puppy encourages him to give out extra fro-yo, he gets carried away and accidentally breaks the fro-yo machine, causing a nasty mess. When Book Cub returns, she is upset, but Love Monster apologises and together with Bad Idea Puppy they clean everything up.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: The Octonauts help when they discover melting permafrost endangering an ecosystem.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Mr McGregor goes away for the day, Peter can't wait to raid the garden. But will the absence of one foe leave Peter and his little sister at the mercy of another?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Zigzag has a sugar crash after eating too many sweet treats at the Explorers' Cookie Day.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Evil Pea steals Supertato's brand new Tato Car but doesn't realise that the Grape Kids are in the back seat. Supertato has to get the Grape Kids back to safety and save his car.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The Ducklings are fed up with Weasy's immaturity, so they use a device to make him more sensible. But when Weasy becomes super serious, the Ducklings want their real dad back.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Tao can’t go on with his circus performance, so there are going to be some disappointed fans, unless Bo agrees to do all the acts for him - with some help from Mojo’s tops!

programme.title: Bluey

programme.title: Bluey

programme.desc: Andy and Jen jump into the magic old museum clock and travel 68 million years back in time for prehistoric adventures on Dino Island. The duo search for a missing baby Pachycephalosaurus called Bumper, who has become separated from his family. Jen looks for him in some nearby caves, while Andy heads to the river.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: AJ takes Evie and Anaya swimming, but Waffle must stay at home with Simon. Refusing to miss out on the fun, Waffle begins an adventure of his own and sets off to find Evie.

When they are stuck outside in the rain, Rafi admits being a cat is harder than she thought. With Deborah’s help, she returns inside and back to herself again. Together with her dads, they create a magical cat flap, so Deborah won’t get stuck outside ever again.

programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are at the beach and begin to look for lots of different types of shells. They also discover a rock pool, some limpets and a hermit crab – which runs away! JoJo realises that all the different elements at the beach make up an ecosystem, so she shouldn’t take any shells home.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: Animation. Umbrella is nervous about meeting up with his pen pal at the Parasol Show, so Sarah and Duck accompany him.

programme.desc: Tiny and Small find a strange silver ball. When it bounces it glows and rings. It bounces into Mother's garden and they are amazed to learn from her that the ball is a living thing, like them. And Granny is convinced it must have friends nearby.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: It’s a windy day, and MeMo and BaBa have fun playing with pinwheels. At Play Time, they fly a kite in the wind. The Yummies show MeMo and BaBa the wind chimes they have made out of recycled cutlery. The chimes sound beautiful as they move in the wind. On Lullaby Lake, Elewhale blows bubbles, and they are caught in the wind as MeMo and BaBa journey on to the Bay of Books for Storytime.

programme.desc: Children's show about a magic place inhabited by toy characters. Igglepiggle tucks himself up in Upsy Daisy's bed. programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: Despite Jamie's best efforts on the pitch, his new Italian side are struggling to get a win and stay out of the relegation zone. Things go from bad to worse when the Vardys' lakeside villa is dramatically burgled, leaving the whole family on edge and considering whether to return home. Becky and the kids escape to the mountains for a much-needed change of scenery and time to think clearly about their situation. On a whistle-stop trip back to the UK, Becky and Jamie stage an elaborate photoshoot but also find a quiet moment to make the big decision: whatever happens with the football, they will bring the kids home. On Easter Sunday in Italy, Becky and Jamie reveal their decision to the kids during an Easter Egg hunt to an overwhelming reaction. Shortly after, Becky and Jamie fly the kids back to the UK, arriving home for an emotional reunion with family and friends. But when the season is over, will Jamie be joining them for good or stay in Italy - or will a whole new adventure begin?

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: Despite Jamie's best efforts on the pitch, his new Italian side are struggling to get a win and stay out of the relegation zone. Things go from bad to worse when the Vardys' lakeside villa is dramatically burgled, leaving the whole family on edge and considering whether to return home. Becky and the kids escape to the mountains for a much-needed change of scenery and time to think clearly about their situation. On a whistle-stop trip back to the UK, Becky and Jamie stage an elaborate photoshoot but also find a quiet moment to make the big decision: whatever happens with the football, they will bring the kids home. On Easter Sunday in Italy, Becky and Jamie reveal their decision to the kids during an Easter Egg hunt to an overwhelming reaction. Shortly after, Becky and Jamie fly the kids back to the UK, arriving home for an emotional reunion with family and friends. But when the season is over, will Jamie be joining them for good or stay in Italy - or will a whole new adventure begin?

programme.title: Ainsley's Taste Of The Bahamas
programme.desc: Join chef Ainsley Harriott as he immerses himself in the food, culture and people of the Bahamas while offering an authentic look at Bahamian life and flavour - in this episode, Ainsley explores the Bahamas' home-grown side as he finds out how you grow salads without soil at Blue Fields and picks ingredients straight from the trees at Chiccharney Farms before discovering the magic of the mangroves - once back in his beachside kitchen, Ainsley proceeds to sizzle a whole snapper.

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: Despite Jamie's best efforts on the pitch, his new Italian side are struggling to get a win and stay out of the relegation zone. Things go from bad to worse when the Vardys' lakeside villa is dramatically burgled, leaving the whole family on edge and considering whether to return home. Becky and the kids escape to the mountains for a much-needed change of scenery and time to think clearly about their situation. On a whistle-stop trip back to the UK, Becky and Jamie stage an elaborate photoshoot but also find a quiet moment to make the big decision: whatever happens with the football, they will bring the kids home. On Easter Sunday in Italy, Becky and Jamie reveal their decision to the kids during an Easter Egg hunt to an overwhelming reaction. Shortly after, Becky and Jamie fly the kids back to the UK, arriving home for an emotional reunion with family and friends. But when the season is over, will Jamie be joining them for good or stay in Italy - or will a whole new adventure begin?

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: Despite Jamie's best efforts on the pitch, his new Italian side are struggling to get a win and stay out of the relegation zone. Things go from bad to worse when the Vardys' lakeside villa is dramatically burgled, leaving the whole family on edge and considering whether to return home. Becky and the kids escape to the mountains for a much-needed change of scenery and time to think clearly about their situation. On a whistle-stop trip back to the UK, Becky and Jamie stage an elaborate photoshoot but also find a quiet moment to make the big decision: whatever happens with the football, they will bring the kids home. On Easter Sunday in Italy, Becky and Jamie reveal their decision to the kids during an Easter Egg hunt to an overwhelming reaction. Shortly after, Becky and Jamie fly the kids back to the UK, arriving home for an emotional reunion with family and friends. But when the season is over, will Jamie be joining them for good or stay in Italy - or will a whole new adventure begin?

programme.desc: Join chef Ainsley Harriott as he immerses himself in the food, culture and people of the Bahamas while offering an authentic look at Bahamian life and flavour - in this episode, Ainsley explores the Bahamas' home-grown side as he finds out how you grow salads without soil at Blue Fields and picks ingredients straight from the trees at Chiccharney Farms before discovering the magic of the mangroves - once back in his beachside kitchen, Ainsley proceeds to sizzle a whole snapper.
